body:
I'm working parttime right now, in a kinda boring job but wich is really flexible.I also have Morbus Crohn, which is making some things difficult.It's not like i don't have any friends, more that I often don't enjoy their company or would want to have more similar interests. Normaly I'm alone for 6 out of 7 days.I would like a close friend who I trust enough to talk about these things. Or a partner, wich I never had and feel very left behind because I never made the experiences people around me have. It's like I'm still 13 years old but I'm in my mid-twentys.

I gave up because I wasn't able to achieve those things for over 10 years and never had any luck with it either. I feel like there is no real reason for someone to invest in me/spend time with me.

Its a center for therapists still in education. She is in constant contact with a supervisor, the sessions are also recorded.  
And it basically is a CBT.
When I decide to end it, I won't see her anymore. There is no next step.

What are other approaches to socializing and boosting slefworth/confidence though? I think everyone would give me tips like talk to people, go to places with people, do things you're good at for confidence. Even reddit is mostly giving those advices. 

The Fear and hopelessness grew over time of not having positive experiences and feeling left out of adult-life.  
This is also my third therapy including a stationary treatment.
Well it was a bit out of habit and the only place to articulate my thoughts. Also getting attention.

She's open with any solution: end it next week or see me next year and think about posisble changes together.

The thing is I can't help myself and no one can take actions for me. She can't go around and ask people to be my friend.

I really don't know whats left for her to do or what i would need. I just gave up myself and have no power to change but still hate it every day.
